description: Notes that link to this one via [[Title]] wikilinks, by id or title. Each comes back as id/title/folder_path plus a snippet around the link; include_content:true returns their full text instead, which is expensive when many notes link here — prefer get_note on the ids you actually want. offset and limit count notes, not characters.

id.description: UUID of the note whose incoming links you want

include_content.description: Return each linking note's full text instead of a snippet around the link. Expensive when many notes link here

limit.description: Linking notes per page. Several links from the same note count as one

offset.description: Skip this many linking notes — pass back next_offset from the previous page

title.description: Alternative to id; resolved like get_note (exact, then prefix, then substring)

name: get_backlinks
